baseline.equivalence: edada4d7 changes only rejection evidence; the MQTT production sources match 87e0d12e

reference.pattern: mosquitto__client_msg stores a refcounted mosquitto__base_msg instead of copying topic and payload at delivery time

implementation.common_representation: PublishTransmission and Transmission retain their original layouts
implementation.selection: A broker-only one-item drain specialization returns DetachableTransmission with a borrowed SharedPublication sidecar. The ordinary drain specialization is comptime-separated and has no owner branch.
implementation.eligibility: Only OwnedPublish.wire_allocation_len == shared_publication_properties exposes the sidecar; restored, ordinary, partially shared-property, and alias-independent ownership continues to deep-copy.
implementation.detach: Property descriptors copy into connection scratch, while Topic Name, payload, and all variable-length property values remain borrowed from one retained Publication.
implementation.release: DetachedSessionPacket releases the retained Publication on success, oversized drop, socket failure, retry, continue, and return paths.
preserved_invariants: durable state commits before network-visible PUBLISH or PUBREL progress
Client ID takeover or concurrent ACK cannot invalidate detached bytes
PUBREL routing and PUBCOMP ordering are unchanged
listener mount-point topic projection remains a subslice of the retained Publication
allocation failure before retain leaves the Session as sole owner and retryable

fixed_binary_serial.claim: Broker instructions improve by about 0.57% in all three paired medians. The 100k decision set also improves cycles, throughput, and p50; p99 is neutral. Shorter timing sets moved in both directions and are not promoted as a general timing claim.

fixed_binary_five_shape.claim: Instructions improve in every shape; fanout, balanced, and 4 KiB payload reductions scale with avoided byte copies. Timing and 2 ms RSS samples are mostly neutral and remain supporting controls rather than universal claims.

profile.workload: 5000 warmup plus 100000 measured serial durable QoS 2 publishes at 199 Hz user cycles with DWARF call graphs

candidate.remaining_detach_memcpy: property descriptor copies; the Topic Name and payload copy is absent

four_sample_five_shape_matrix.scope: same-client loopback shapes, not equal-wire or universal broker superiority

mosquitto_comparison.remaining_gap: Long serial durable QoS 2 throughput and every measured broker RSS shape remain behind Mosquitto.

matrix_packaging_fix.problem: The timing matrix copied a 260 MiB ReleaseFast broker with DWARF into identity and exceeded its 128 MiB artifact cap after all 40 runs.
matrix_packaging_fix.fix: Archive and execute install -s identity copies, matching the allocator matrix; hashes now identify the exact stripped loadable code used by every sample.
